items.quote: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
items.claim: Noah built an altar to the LORD, took every clean beast and fowl, and offered them as burnt offerings on the altar.
